title: The Week Board
notes: Your week is now a card game: every task is a card in your hand. Tap a card to play it into your week.
Combos: play the right cards together in the same week for bonuses, such as Studio flow, Fan frenzy and Recharged.
Instant feedback: stat changes float up, cards fly into their slots, confetti for combos, five-star shows and No. 1 debuts, and a reveal when you wrap the week.
Energy, Hype and Blocks rings on the stage, filters for your hand, and a deadline strip.
A livelier look with moving background light and glossy cards.
